notes.title: Update announcement
notes.notes:
According to the feedback of family members, update the following contents:
1. New replacement function
2. Modify the dice winning rate, but cannot modify the player's character probability.
3. Fix some known bugs
Please update the game and dlc patch again because of the modification
Thank you again for your support and attention!
